release_title: Round8: frozen postcal candidate, independent source confirmation and measured costs
release_body: Incremental frozen research evidence. Calibration KL, exposed development quality, post-freeze source confirmation and bounded cost measurements have distinct roles. Execution completion does not imply a quality or speed advantage. Exact archive bytes, original source SHA and normalized LF Git identities are recorded separately. Earlier history, releases and assets are retained.
domain_scope: Doc is a fresh source holdout drawn from the official training split. Text and InfoVQA are fresh official-validation source pools. InfoVQA remains separate from DocVQA despite sharing ANLS. No result pools are combined into a single quality score.
cpu_scope: CPU fixtures validate contracts only and do not count as model task-quality answers. Failed trainer v1 is preserved and excluded from accepted calibration/quality.
scope: Completed research inputs: matched cap8 development, one frozen fixed200 postcal candidate, three separate post-freeze source-confirmation domains, training/deployment first-target diagnostic, continuous8 and quiet6. No robust quality-cost frontier improvement was established. Exact archive/source/LF-Git identities and remote publication/history remain for root verification. Failed training/Mean traces and CPU fixtures are excluded from task quality; original images, weights, tensors, credentials, private chats and raw maintenance remain private.
model_config_metadata_scope: Exact original model config JSON only, pinned to producer SHA; no model weights or images
